tools.name: find_dataset
tools.description: Search the engineering code-table datasets by keyword (standard, table, quantity, material). Returns up to 10 matches, each with its id, title, standard, edition and table, whether lookups return a value or a pointer (table, row and column only), and the tier at which values are returned.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: Describe one dataset: the key fields a lookup needs, the value columns with units and which need a temperature, the citation (standard, edition, table), whether lookups return a value or a pointer, the tier at which values are returned, and the daily lookup limits. Returns structure only, no table v

tools.name: lookup_value
tools.description: Return one value from one row and one column of a code-table dataset, with its citation (standard, edition, table, row, column), unit and the tabulated entries used. Temperature columns take T in °F; allowable-stress and flange-rating columns interpolate linearly between the two bracketing tabulated

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: List the key identifiers of a dataset's rows (for example spec, grade, class, size, and the row position `line`) so lookup_value can address exactly one row. Returns identifiers only, never table values, at most 50 per call; `prefix` filters on the first key field. For pointer datasets it returns th

tools.name: get_pointer
tools.description: For a quantity whose value this server does not return (for example PVP2011-57100 nozzle allowables, ASCE 7-22 SDS, Ip, CAR and Rpo, AISC Fy/Fu, ACI anchor product values, API 617/611/612 and NEMA SM 23 coefficients, API 650 Annex P coefficients, and any dataset currently returned as a location only

tools.name: get_skey_map
tools.description: Return the Isogen-style SKEY vocabulary Piping Toolset uses (component prefixes, end-condition suffixes, fitting and support keys) with scope 'isogen', or the PCF record set, substitutions and default SKEYs that import cleanly into CAESAR II with scope 'caesar-safe'. `component` narrows the result t

tools.name: get_fixture_example
tools.description: Return one worked example case for a Piping Toolset plugin skill: the inputs, the expected outputs and the pass/fail status from the hand-checked calculation fixtures, with case names removed. `case` selects among the skill's cases (0-based; the result gives the count).

tools.name: get_aisc_shape
tools.description: Return the dimensions and section properties of one AISC shape by designation (e.g. W8X31, HSS6X6X3/8, PIPE4STD, L4X4X1/2): weight, area, depth, flange and web dimensions, I, S, Z, r, J and Cw as applicable. Source: AISC Shapes Database v16.0; L, HSS and Pipe computed from nominal geometry.

tools.name: get_pipe_dimensions
tools.description: Return the outside diameter and nominal wall thickness (in) for a nominal pipe size per ASME B36.10M / B36.19M: one schedule with its wall and inside diameter when `schedule` is given (e.g. 40, STD, XS, 80, 10S), otherwise the walls of every schedule listed at that size.

tools.name: verify_connector
tools.description: Report whether the caller is signed in, the caller's tier, how many datasets return values at that tier, and the remaining daily lookups when the server tracks them. Returns no email, name or account id.
